title: Project Staff Engineer (On-site)
description:
HEPCO Inc. is seeking a Project Staff Engineer to support energy efficiency initiatives within the Customer Energy Solutions organization. This role leverages a strong foundation in energy engineering, financial analysis, and project oversight to ensure the successful delivery of energy efficiency programs.

The ideal candidate will play a critical role in evaluating energy savings, reviewing technical designs, and ensuring projects meet performance and cost-effectiveness targets. This includes working closely with stakeholders to validate engineering models, audits, and post-construction performance.

  • Provide engineering support for energy efficiency projects, with a focus on energy savings calculations and validation
  • Conduct technical evaluations of investment-grade audits performed by third parties
  • Review engineering design documents and energy models to ensure accuracy and compliance
  • Perform technical QA/QC during and after construction to verify projected energy savings are achieved
  • Evaluate and validate multimillion-dollar project savings estimates using technical resource manuals and sound engineering principles
  • Oversee small to mid-sized projects, ensuring quality, cost-effectiveness, and compliance
  • Interface with internal stakeholders, vendors, customers, and consultants to ensure program requirements are met
  • Support regulatory reporting by ensuring accurate and timely technical data
  • Identify, assess, and standardize complex energy savings methodologies across Commercial & Industrial and Multifamily programs
  • Develop technical documentation, tools, and engineering calculators to streamline reviews and improve deliverable quality
  • Apply business and financial principles to evaluate project cost-effectiveness and performance

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering
  • Minimum 2+ years of experience in energy efficiency projects or project management within construction, HVAC, or mechanical systems (C&I environments)
  • Strong knowledge of Commercial & Industrial and Multifamily energy efficiency measures
  • Strong understanding of energy savings methodologies and techniques
  • Familiarity with ASHRAE standards, NJ Technical Reference Manual (TRM), and applicable building codes
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills
  • Demonstrated leadership ability on projects or initiatives
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Word
  • Valid driver’s license with ability to travel within New Jersey
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment
  • Commitment to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certified Energy Manager (CEM) – Association of Energy Engineers (AEE)
  • LEED Certification, Professional Engineer (PE), or Lean Six Sigma
  • Advanced Excel skills including complex formulas and VBA macros
  • Experience with building energy modeling software such as eQUEST, EnergyPlus, or TRACE 3D
  • Familiarity with advanced building controls and energy-saving methodologies

title: Assembler (On-site)
description:
Our client is seeking an electrical assembler to support production operations within a clean room manufacturing environment. This is a fully onsite position supporting advanced electronics and defense-related systems. Candidates must be comfortable working a 4/10 schedule on 1st shift (Monday–Thursday, typically 6:00 AM – 4:30 PM).

  • Assemble, disassemble, and modify electromechanical and electronic production subassemblies following work instructions and process plans
  • Perform conformal coat masking and coating on electronic assemblies
  • Conduct conformal coating inspections to ensure quality and compliance standards are met
  • Utilize fine brushes and masking materials to coat small features with precision and accuracy
  • Work under slight magnification for the majority of the shift
  • Read and interpret schematics, blueprints, process plans, drawings, and work instructions
  • Inspect parts and materials for flaws and imperfections prior to use
  • Perform self-inspection of completed work to ensure production quality
  • Utilize fixturing to accurately build assemblies
  • Manually solder or epoxy electrical components as required
  • Operate manufacturing equipment including solder reflow ovens, semi-automated P&P machines, and automated measurement systems
  • Maintain accurate production and data collection records
  • Work effectively within a team-oriented clean room environment

Qualifications

  • Two (2) years of High School or Trade School education required
  • Prior conformal coating inspection experience strongly preferred
  • Prior experience with conformal coat masking and coating preferred
  • Ability to work meticulously with masking tape and fine-detail assembly work
  • Ability to use a fine brush with a steady hand to coat small features
  • Ability to work under magnification for extended periods of time
  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and quality standards
  • Ability to read and interpret work instructions and technical drawings
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Basic computer skills including Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook
  • IPC-A-610 and J-STD certifications are desirable
  • Ability to become solder certified preferred

  • Health Insurance

  • 401k
